title: ESP8266 dual relay controller
goal: A reader must be able to trace each ESP8266 output through its transistor to a distinct protected 5 V relay channel.

rubric.must: A clearly labelled ESP8266 module is visible with separate GPIO12 and GPIO13 connections.
Two separately labelled relay channels are visible and distinguishable as Relay 1 and Relay 2.
Each relay coil is connected to its own labelled NPN transistor driver.
A labelled flyback diode is shown across each relay coil.
Each relay channel has its own labelled green indicator LED and series resistor.
The 5 V input and regulated 3.3 V supply are both labelled and visibly distinct.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Split into supply, controller and two relay channels; each channel has its own base resistor, transistor, flyback diode and indicator, and stays visually separate from the other. Cross-section connections are made by named rails with a note saying so, rather than by dragging wires across the sheet.
